| Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| ἅρπῃ ἐϊκυῖα τανυπτέρυγι λιγυφώνῳ (19.350; ἅρπη, a bird of prey, which bird not known) | "to a bird of prey likened, long-winged, clear-voiced" | "like a long-winged, clear-voiced bird of prey" | "hawk", "falcon", "kite", "harpy" (each picks a bird); λιγύς "clear" as in the table’s λιγέως |
| νέκταρ … ἀμβροσίην ἐρατεινήν (19.347, 353) | "nectar … lovely ambrosia" | "nectar … lovely ambrosia" | "delightful" (reserved for ἐραννός), "desirable"; follows the table’s ἐρατεινός "lovely" |
| λιμὸς ἀτερπής (19.354) | "joyless hunger" | "joyless hunger" | "cheerless", "grim"; ἀτερπής "joyless" as in the table’s ἀτερπέα δαῖτα |
| ἄκμηνος καὶ ἄπαστος (19.346) | "fasting and tasting nothing" | "goes fasting, tasting nothing" | "starved", "unfed" (iliad-124’s ἄκμηνος σίτοιο), "without food"; ἄκμηνος "fasting" as in iliad-125 |
| πατρὸς ἐρισθενέος (19.355) | "her father, great in strength" | "her father, great in strength" | "mighty" (reserved for ἴφθιμος, ὄβριμος); follows the table’s ἐρισθενής |
| πυκινὸν δῶ (19.355) | "the solid house" | "the solid house" | "close-built", "thick-walled"; follows the Odyssey’s πυκινὸς δόμος |
| κόρυθες λαμπρὸν γανόωσαι (19.359) | "helmets, brightly gleaming" | "gleaming brightly" | follows the table’s λαμπρὸν γανόωντες |
| κραταιγύαλοι θώρηκες (19.361) | "strong-hollowed breastplates" | "strong-hollowed breastplates" (+ note: γύαλον the curved plate) | "strong-plated", "stout-plated" (each decides what γύαλα are); γύαλον "hollow" as in the table |
| γέλασσε δὲ πᾶσα περὶ χθών (19.362) | "all the earth round about laughed" | "all the earth round about laughed" (+ note: it shines) | "smiled", "shone" alone (turns the figure into plain speech) |
| μενεαίνων (Τρωσὶν μενεαίνων, 19.367) | "in eagerness against the Trojans" | "in his eagerness against the Trojans" | "raging", "furious", "fierce" (each supplies a feeling); follows the table’s μενεαίνω "eager" |
| ἄχος ἄτλητον (19.367) | "unbearable grief" | "unbearable grief" | "intolerable", "unendurable", "sorrow"; ἄχος "grief" |
| δῶρα θεοῦ, τά οἱ Ἥφαιστος κάμε τεύχων (19.368) | "the gifts of the god, which Hephaestus toiled to make for him" | "which Hephaestus had toiled to make for him" | "forged" (decides the craft), "fashioned"; κάμνω "toil" |
| σάκος … σέλας γένετ’ ἠΰτε μήνης (19.374) | "a gleam came to be, as of the moon" | "a gleam came from it far off, like the moon’s" | "shone like the moon"; σέλας "gleam" |
| ἰχθυόεντα πόντον (19.378) | "the fish-teeming sea" | "the fish-teeming sea" | "fishy" (turned down at 9.360); follows the table’s ἰχθυόεις |
| ἄελλαι (19.377) | "blasts" | "the blasts of the wind" | "gales", "tempests", "storms"; follows the table’s ἄελλα "blast" |
| οἰοπόλῳ σταθμῷ (19.377) | "a lonely steading" | "a lonely steading" (+ note: ‘lonely’ not certain) | "sheep-haunted", "solitary" |
| βριαρὴν τρυφάλειαν (19.380–381) | "the weighty one" (helm) | "the weighty helmet" | "stout" (kept for στιβαρός), "heavy" (kept for βριθύς), "strong"; τρυφάλεια "helm" / "helmet" as in the table |
| ἵππουρις τρυφάλεια (19.382) | "horse-tailed helm" | "the helmet with its horsetail plume" | follows the table’s ἵππουρις |
| ἔθειραι χρύσεαι (19.382–383) | "plumes, golden" | "the golden plumes" | "hairs", "tresses", "manes"; ἔθειρα is the hair of the plume |
| τῷ δ’ εὖτε πτερὰ γίγνετ’ (19.386; εὖτε "like", not "when") | "to him it became like wings" | "to him it became like wings" | "when" (the usual sense of εὖτε), "as if it were wings" |
| ἐκ δ’ ἄρα σύριγγος … ἔγχος (19.387) | "from the case … spear" | "from its case" | "from the pipe", "from the sheath" (a spear-case is not a sheath); σύριγξ "tube" |
| Πηλιάδα μελίην … φόνον ἔμμεναι ἡρώεσσιν (19.390–391) | as iliad-100 (16.141–144) | as iliad-100 | reused verbatim, with the unit ending in a semicolon here |
| λέπαδν’ (19.393) | "yoke-straps" | "yoke-straps" (+ note: exact fitting unclear) | "breast-straps", "traces"; follows the table’s λέπαδνα |
| κολλητὸν ποτὶ δίφρον (19.395) | "the well-joined chariot" | "the well-joined chariot" | "glued", "close-set", "chariot-board"; κολλητός "joined" |
| ἀραρυῖαν (μάστιγα φαεινὴν … ἀραρυῖαν, 19.395–396) | "well-fitted" | "well-fitted" | "stout", "firm"; ἀραρίσκω "fit" as at 19.370 |
| ἵπποιιν (ἐφ’ ἵπποιιν, 19.396; dual) | "upon the pair of horses" | "behind the pair of horses" | "on the horses’ backs" (he mounts the car, not the horses) |
| τεύχεσι παμφαίνων ὥς τ’ ἠλέκτωρ Ὑπερίων (19.398) | "all-shining in his armour like the sun, Hyperion" | "shining all over in his armour like the sun, Hyperion" (+ note: ἠλέκτωρ meaning not certain) | "amber", "the beaming one" (each decides the sense); παμφαίνων "all-shining" as in iliad-064 |
| σμερδαλέον … ἐκέκλετο (19.399) | "frightfully … he called" | "he called out frightfully" | "terribly", "gave orders" (the table’s ἐκέκλετο with an order; here he calls to them); σμερδαλέον "frightfully" as in iliad-010 |
| τηλεκλυτὰ τέκνα Ποδάργης (19.400) | "far-famed children of Podarge" | "far-famed children of Podarge" | "renowned", "children of the Harpy"; follows the table’s τηλεκλυτός "far-famed" |
| ἄλλως δὴ φράζεσθε σαωσέμεν (19.401) | "in another way, now, take thought to save" | "take thought now in another way for the saving of" | "idly" (the table’s ἄλλως, 14.124: here the sense is "otherwise"), "differently this time" (adds a reference to the past) |
| ἡνιοχῆα (19.401) | "charioteer" | "charioteer" (+ note: Automedon or Achilles not said) | "driver", "your master"; ἡνίοχος |
| ἐπεί χ’ ἕωμεν πολέμοιο (19.402) | "when we have had our fill of war" | "when we have had our fill of war" | "when we have done with war", "when we have had enough"; ἅδην "to one’s fill" at 19.423 uses the same image |
| πόδας αἰόλος ἵππος (19.404) | "the nimble-footed horse" | "the horse Xanthus, nimble of foot" (+ note: αἰόλος "quick" or "dappled", not certain) | "swift-footed" (reserved for ποδώκης), "swift of foot" (πόδας ὠκύς), "dappled", "gleaming" (each picks a sense) |
| ζεύγλη (19.406) | "yoke-pad" | "yoke-pad" (+ note: exact fitting not clear) | "yoke-loop", "collar", "yoke-strap"; kept apart from λέπαδνα "yoke-straps" |
| ὑπὸ ζυγόφι (19.404) | "from under the yoke" | "from under the yoke" | "beneath the yoke"; -φι ending |
| ἤμυσε καρήατι (19.405) | "bowed with his head" | "bowed his head" | "nodded", "drooped"; κάρη "head" |
| αὐδήεντα … ἔθηκε (19.407) | "endowed with speech she made him" | "had given him a human voice" (+ note: force of αὐδήεις debated) | "vocal", "gave him speech" alone, "a voice of a man"; follows the Odyssey’s αὐδήεσσα "endowed with speech" / "with a human voice" |
| καὶ λίην σ’ ἔτι νῦν γε σαώσομεν (19.408) | "And truly, you, even now at least, we will save" | "Indeed, we shall save you even now" | "yes, we will bring you home", "keep you safe"; follows the table’s καὶ λίην "truly" |
| ὄβριμ’ Ἀχιλλεῦ (19.408) | "mighty Achilles" | "mighty Achilles" | "strong" (kept for κρατερός), "stout"; the table’s ὄβριμος "mighty" |
| θεός τε μέγας καὶ Μοῖρα κραταιή (19.410) | "a great god and strong Portion" | "a great god and strong Fate" | "mighty Fate", "Destiny", "Doom" (reserved for πότμος); follows the table’s Μοῖρα "Portion" / "Fate", κρατερός "strong" |
| βραδυτῆτί τε νωχελίῃ τε (19.411) | "slowness and sluggishness" | "slowness or sluggishness" | "laziness", "slackness", "delay"; two nouns, βραδυτής "slowness" |
| θεῶν ὤριστος, ὃν ἠΰκομος τέκε Λητώ (19.413) | "of the gods the best, whom fine-haired Leto bore" | "the best of the gods, whom fine-haired Leto bore" | "noblest", "mightiest" (Apollo is named by description, not by name); ἠΰκομος "fine-haired" |
| ἔκταν’ ἐνὶ προμάχοισι καὶ Ἕκτορι κῦδος ἔδωκε (19.414) | as iliad-120 (18.454) | as iliad-120 | reused: "killed among the front-fighters / foremost fighters, and gave glory to Hector" |
| πνοιῇ Ζεφύροιο (19.415) | "the blowing of the West Wind" | "the breath of the West Wind" | "Zephyr"; follows the table’s Ζέφυρος "West Wind" and ἀνέμου ὡς πνοιή "a breath of wind" |
| ἐλαφροτάτην (19.416) | "the lightest" | "the lightest of winds" | "swiftest" (reserved for θοός, ὠκύς), "nimblest"; follows the table’s ἐλαφρότατος "lightest" |
| μόρσιμόν ἐστι … ἶφι δαμῆναι (19.417) | "it is fated … to be overpowered by force" | "are fated to be overpowered by force" | "mastered", "laid low", "doomed"; ἶφι "by force" (table: ἶφι ἄνασσεν "with force"), μόρσιμον "allotted, fated" as at 15.613 |
| Ἐρινύες ἔσχεθον αὐδήν (19.418) | "the Erinyes held back his voice" | "the Erinyes checked his voice" | "Furies" (the Latin name), "silenced", "stopped"; Ἐρινύες "Erinyes" as in the table |
| τὸν δὲ μέγ’ ὀχθήσας προσέφη πόδας ὠκὺς Ἀχιλλεύς (19.419) | as iliad-099 (16.48) | as iliad-099 | reused verbatim |
| τί μοι θάνατον μαντεύεαι (19.420) | "why do you prophesy death to me" | "why do you prophesy my death" | "foretell", "predict", "divine"; μαντεύομαι "prophesy" |
| οὐδέ τί σε χρή (19.420) | "There is no need at all for you." | "There is no need for you at all." | "it is not for you", "you have no business"; χρή "it is necessary" |
| ἅδην ἐλάσαι πολέμοιο (19.423) | "driven the Trojans to their fill of war" | "driven the Trojans to their fill of war" | "enough", "sated"; ἅδην "to one’s fill" |
| ἔχε μώνυχας ἵππους (19.424) | "drove the solid-hoofed horses" | "drove the solid-hoofed horses on" | "held", "kept"; follows the table’s μώνυχες ἵπποι "solid-hoofed horses" and ἔχε "drove" (5.829) |
